title: QUIZ - 39
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Distributing and Combining Like Terms
questions.learningObjective: Simplify an expression that requires distributing before combining like terms
questions.question: Simplify: \( 2(x + 2) + 4x - 8 \)
questions.explanation: Distribute first: 2(x + 2) = 2x + 4. Then combine like terms: (2+4)x + (4-8) = 6x + -4.
questions.hint: Distribute any multiplication over parentheses first, then combine like terms.

questions.concept: Simplifying Expressions with Variables and Constants
questions.learningObjective: Simplify an expression by combining like variable terms and constant terms separately
questions.question: Simplify: \( 4t + 4 + 9t - 5 \)
questions.explanation: Combine the t terms (4 + 9 = 13) and the constants (4 - 5 = -1) separately to get \( 13t - 1 \).
questions.hint: Group and combine the variable terms, then group and combine the constant terms.
